description: Dependency PRs target the active integration branch, never main. The
release flow makes main the released version, so a PR into it would be
an independent commit target. Roll this at each dev-line cut; a stale
pattern matches nothing and silently stops producing PRs.

packageRules.description: Queue major upgrades in the dependency dashboard until selected.
The Mac app ended at v0.19.2; do not update its retired release workflow.
